itemTooltip.hayatemod.gale_fan: Right-click: blows everything in front of you away
enchantment.hayatemod.gale_step.desc: Increases movement speed while worn on the feet.
itemTooltip.hayatemod.gale_charm: A burst of wind, then nothing but dust
commands.hayatemod.about: HayateMod %1$s - running on unobfuscated Minecraft %2$s with Fabric API
commands.hayatemod.boost.success: Gave Speed %3$s to %1$s player(s) for %2$s seconds
itemTooltip.hayatemod.gale_staff: Right-click to ride the wind (1.5s cooldown)
itemTooltip.hayatemod.greater_gale_charm: Speed III for 45s, then a soft landing
enen.hayatemod.generating: Laying out the alley through the rice paddies...
enen.hayatemod.intro.title: Entering the En'en Azemichi!
enen.hayatemod.intro.2: Right-click an encounter and answer with the 1/2/3 keys.
enen.hayatemod.intro.3: Pass the torii at %1$d m to clear it. Once per day.
enen.hayatemod.choice.busy: You already have a question open. Pick one.
enen.hayatemod.choice.timeout: You took too long... the moment passed.
enen.hayatemod.milestone.1000: 1000 m. You can't see the other side of the paddies.
enen.hayatemod.milestone.half: Halfway. Anything can come out there.
enen.hayatemod.milestone.200: 200 m. You can see the torii!
enen.hayatemod.boss.blocked: A giant cat blocks the torii! Defeat Bishatatsu!
enen.hayatemod.clear.title: Goal! You passed the torii!
enen.hayatemod.exit.scarecrow: You poked the scarecrow. Escaping the azemichi.
enen.hayatemod.event.vending.name: Vending Machine
enen.hayatemod.event.vending.question: A vending machine hums. How much do you put in? (emerald = coin)
enen.hayatemod.event.vending.closer: ...and the exit got a little closer.
enen.hayatemod.event.vending.battle: A yokai leaps out of the machine!
enen.hayatemod.event.vending.feather: A gale feather drops out. The exit got closer.
enen.hayatemod.event.vending.orb: A gale orb! The exit is much closer now.
enen.hayatemod.event.phone.name: Phone Booth
enen.hayatemod.event.phone.question: The phone keeps ringing. What do you do?
enen.hayatemod.event.phone.charm: A 'nyan' from the line... something is in your hand.
enen.hayatemod.event.phone.farther: Listening to the end pushed the exit a little further.
enen.hayatemod.event.phone.closer: You hang up. The exit got a little closer.
enen.hayatemod.event.old_lady.name: Old Lady
enen.hayatemod.event.old_lady.reveal: The old lady's face... spider legs grow from it!
enen.hayatemod.event.train.name: Train
enen.hayatemod.event.train.question: A train comes down the tracks. What do you do?
enen.hayatemod.event.train.boarded: The train races down the azemichi! A big leap forward... but the exit moved further.
enen.hayatemod.event.train.passed: The train disappears into the distance. Next time.
enen.hayatemod.event.scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
enen.hayatemod.event.monster.name: The Dazed Man
enen.hayatemod.event.monster.question: "Um... what were you holding on that deserted island?"
enen.hayatemod.event.monster.shovel: "Correct!" A yokai appears... it left you an orb.
enen.hayatemod.event.monster.phone: A yokai appears... and the exit moved further!
enen.hayatemod.event.monster.money: "That's it!" The exit is much closer now.
commands.hayatemod.enen.failed: Can't start right now (already running or the once-per-day limit)
commands.hayatemod.enen.active: You're still inside the azemichi. Leave with /hayate enen exit
commands.hayatemod.enen.daily: Once per day only. Come back tomorrow! (/hayate enen force to override)
commands.hayatemod.enen.not_in: You're not inside the azemichi right now.
commands.hayatemod.enen.status: Distance %1$d m / goal %2$d m / battles %3$d / events %4$d / clears %5$d
commands.hayatemod.enen.status.none: Not currently on the azemichi. Clears: %1$d
